items.question: Trong câu "TLS sits awkwardly between 4 and 7, and QUIC is a transport built on UDP", từ "awkwardly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "TLS sits awkwardly between 4 and 7, and QUIC is a transport built on UDP", what does "awkwardly" (adverb) mean?
options: một cách lấn cấn, không khớp
optionsEn: in a way that does not fit well
items.explanation: awkwardly /ˈɔːk.wəd.li/ (trạng từ): một cách lấn cấn, không khớp. "Sit awkwardly between A and B" = nằm lấn cấn giữa A và B, khó xếp vào hẳn một bên.
items.explanationEn: awkwardly /ˈɔːk.wəd.li/ (adverb): in a way that does not fit well. "Sit awkwardly between A and B" means it does not clearly belong to either side.

items.question: Trong câu "QUIC is a transport built on UDP — do not argue about it", từ "argue" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "QUIC is a transport built on UDP — do not argue about it", what does "argue" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: argue /ˈɑːɡ.juː/ (động từ): tranh cãi. "Argue about something" = tranh cãi về điều gì; "argue that..." lại mang nghĩa lập luận rằng.
items.explanationEn: argue /ˈɑːɡ.juː/ (verb): to disagree in words. "Argue about something" means to disagree over it; "argue that..." means to give reasons for a claim.

items.question: Trong câu "a security group is almost free, a WAF parsing every body is not.", từ "parse" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "a security group is almost free, a WAF parsing every body is not.", what does "parse" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to analyse the structure of data
items.explanation: parse /pɑːz/ (động từ): phân tích cú pháp. "Parse a request/JSON/header" = đọc và phân tích cấu trúc dữ liệu; danh từ: parser (bộ phân tích).
items.explanationEn: parse /pɑːz/ (verb): to analyse the structure of data. "Parse a request/JSON/header" means to read data and break it into its structure; noun: parser.

items.question: Trong câu "The higher the layer a component understands, the smarter its decisions and the more CPU and latency it costs", từ "latency" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The higher the layer a component understands, the smarter its decisions and the more CPU and latency it costs", what does "latency" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: latency /ˈleɪ.tən.si/ (danh từ): độ trễ. "Low/high latency" = độ trễ thấp/cao; thường đi với "add latency" (làm tăng độ trễ).
items.explanationEn: latency /ˈleɪ.tən.si/ (noun): delay before data arrives. "Low/high latency" is a common collocation; "add latency" means to make things slower to respond.

items.question: Trong câu "Each layer wraps the payload above it with its own header.", từ "wrap" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each layer wraps the payload above it with its own header.", what does "wrap" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: wrap /ræp/ (động từ): bọc, gói lại. "Wrap A with/in B" = bọc A bằng B; trong lập trình còn có "wrapper" (lớp bọc).
items.explanationEn: wrap /ræp/ (verb): to enclose inside something. "Wrap A with/in B" means to put B around A; in programming a "wrapper" is a layer around something.

items.question: Trong câu "Each layer wraps the payload above it with its own header.", từ "payload" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each layer wraps the payload above it with its own header.", what does "payload" (noun) mean?
options: phần dữ liệu chính được mang
items.explanation: payload /ˈpeɪ.ləʊd/ (danh từ): phần dữ liệu chính được mang. Trong mạng, payload là phần dữ liệu thật, không tính header; nghĩa gốc là hàng hóa/trọng tải.
items.explanationEn: payload /ˈpeɪ.ləʊd/ (noun): the actual data being carried. In networking the payload is the real data, excluding headers; the original sense is cargo.

items.question: Trong câu "Inside an AWS VPC most current instance types support 9,001-byte jumbo frames, but traffic leaving the VPC (internet gateway, VPN) is limited to 1,500 or less.", từ "jumbo" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Inside an AWS VPC most current instance types support 9,001-byte jumbo frames, but traffic leaving the VPC (internet gateway, VPN) is limited to 1,500 or less.", what does "jumbo" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: jumbo /ˈdʒʌm.bəʊ/ (tính từ): cỡ lớn khác thường. "Jumbo frames" = khung dữ liệu cỡ lớn (trên 1.500 byte); cũng gặp trong "jumbo jet".
items.explanationEn: jumbo /ˈdʒʌm.bəʊ/ (adjective): unusually large. "Jumbo frames" are frames larger than 1,500 bytes; also seen in "jumbo jet".

items.question: Trong câu "Inside an AWS VPC most current instance types support 9,001-byte jumbo frames, but traffic leaving the VPC (internet gateway, VPN) is limited to 1,500 or less.", từ "limit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Inside an AWS VPC most current instance types support 9,001-byte jumbo frames, but traffic leaving the VPC (internet gateway, VPN) is limited to 1,500 or less.", what does "limit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: limit /ˈlɪm.ɪt/ (động từ): giới hạn. "Be limited to X" = bị giới hạn ở mức X; danh từ: limit (giới hạn), limitation (hạn chế).
items.explanationEn: limit /ˈlɪm.ɪt/ (verb): to restrict to a maximum. "Be limited to X" means X is the maximum allowed; nouns: limit, limitation.

items.question: Trong câu "MSS is the TCP payload per segment, announced in the SYN.", từ "announce" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "MSS is the TCP payload per segment, announced in the SYN.", what does "announce" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: announce /əˈnaʊns/ (động từ): thông báo, công bố. MSS được "announced" = được thông báo cho phía bên kia trong gói SYN; danh từ: announcement.
items.explanationEn: announce /əˈnaʊns/ (verb): to declare openly. The MSS is announced, i.e. declared to the other side in the SYN; noun: announcement.

items.question: Trong câu "Tunnels and VPNs add headers and trigger this often — clamp the MSS.", từ "trigger" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Tunnels and VPNs add headers and trigger this often — clamp the MSS.", what does "trigger" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: trigger /ˈtrɪɡ.ər/ (động từ): gây ra, kích hoạt. "Trigger an error/event" = gây ra lỗi/sự kiện; danh từ "trigger" = cò súng, tác nhân kích hoạt.
items.explanationEn: trigger /ˈtrɪɡ.ər/ (verb): to cause to happen. "Trigger an error/event" means to cause it; the noun "trigger" is the thing that sets it off.

items.question: Trong câu "Tunnels and VPNs add headers and trigger this often — clamp the MSS.", từ "clamp" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Tunnels and VPNs add headers and trigger this often — clamp the MSS.", what does "clamp" (verb) mean?
options: ép xuống dưới một giới hạn
optionsEn: to hold with a metal tool
to force a value under a limit
items.explanation: clamp /klæmp/ (động từ): ép xuống dưới một giới hạn. "Clamp the MSS" = ép MSS nhỏ lại để gói tin vừa đường hầm; nghĩa gốc là kẹp chặt.
items.explanationEn: clamp /klæmp/ (verb): to force a value under a limit. "Clamp the MSS" means forcing it down so packets fit the tunnel; the literal sense is to grip tightly.

items.question: Trong câu "TCP gives an ordered, reliable byte stream over an unreliable network, paid for with per-connection state and round trips.", từ "ordered" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "TCP gives an ordered, reliable byte stream over an unreliable network, paid for with per-connection state and round trips.", what does "ordered" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: ordered /ˈɔː.dəd/ (tính từ): có thứ tự. "An ordered stream" = luồng giữ đúng thứ tự; từ trái nghĩa: unordered, out of order.
items.explanationEn: ordered /ˈɔː.dəd/ (adjective): arranged in sequence. "An ordered stream" keeps items in sequence; opposites: unordered, out of order.

items.question: Trong câu "TCP gives an ordered, reliable byte stream over an unreliable network, paid for with per-connection state and round trips.", từ "reliable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "TCP gives an ordered, reliable byte stream over an unreliable network, paid for with per-connection state and round trips.", what does "reliable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: reliable /rɪˈlaɪ.ə.bəl/ (tính từ): đáng tin cậy. Trái nghĩa: unreliable (không tin cậy); danh từ: reliability (độ tin cậy).
items.explanationEn: reliable /rɪˈlaɪ.ə.bəl/ (adjective): dependable. Opposite: unreliable; noun: reliability.

items.question: Trong câu "Sequence numbers and ACKs detect loss and reorder bytes; lost segments are retransmitted.", từ "retransmit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sequence numbers and ACKs detect loss and reorder bytes; lost segments are retransmitted.", what does "retransmit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: retransmit /ˌriː.trænzˈmɪt/ (động từ): truyền lại. Tiền tố "re-" = lại; danh từ: retransmission (sự truyền lại).
items.explanationEn: retransmit /ˌriː.trænzˈmɪt/ (verb): to send again. The prefix "re-" means again; noun: retransmission.

items.question: Trong câu "Flow control: the receiver advertises a window so a fast sender cannot overrun it.", từ "advertise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Flow control: the receiver advertises a window so a fast sender cannot overrun it.", what does "advertise" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: advertise /ˈæd.və.taɪz/ (động từ): thông báo một giá trị. Trong giao thức mạng, "advertise" = công bố thông tin (window, route) cho bên kia.
items.explanationEn: advertise /ˈæd.və.taɪz/ (verb): to announce a value. In protocols, "advertise" means to announce information such as a window or route to peers.

items.question: Trong câu "Flow control: the receiver advertises a window so a fast sender cannot overrun it.", từ "overrun" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Flow control: the receiver advertises a window so a fast sender cannot overrun it.", what does "overrun" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: overrun /ˌəʊ.vəˈrʌn/ (động từ): làm tràn quá sức chứa. "Overrun a buffer/receiver" = gửi quá nhiều làm tràn; "buffer overrun" là lỗi tràn bộ đệm.
items.explanationEn: overrun /ˌəʊ.vəˈrʌn/ (verb): to overwhelm past capacity. "Overrun a buffer/receiver" means sending more than it can hold; "buffer overrun" is a known bug.

items.question: Trong câu "Congestion control (CUBIC is the Linux default, BBR is common at big providers) starts small — an initial window of 10 segments — and grows.", từ "congestion" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Congestion control (CUBIC is the Linux default, BBR is common at big providers) starts small — an initial window of 10 segments — and grows.", what does "congestion" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: congestion /kənˈdʒes.tʃən/ (danh từ): sự tắc nghẽn. "Network congestion" = tắc nghẽn mạng; "traffic congestion" = kẹt xe.
items.explanationEn: congestion /kənˈdʒes.tʃən/ (noun): overload that slows traffic. "Network congestion" is too much traffic on a link; "traffic congestion" is the road equivalent.

items.question: Trong câu "Head-of-line blocking: one lost segment stalls every byte behind it.", từ "stall" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Head-of-line blocking: one lost segment stalls every byte behind it.", what does "stall" (verb) mean?
options: cố tình kéo dài thời gian
items.explanation: stall /stɔːl/ (động từ): làm đình trệ, chặn lại. "Stall" = làm đứng lại; cũng dùng "the request stalls" (yêu cầu bị treo).
items.explanationEn: stall /stɔːl/ (verb): to cause to stop moving. "Stall" means to stop progress; "the request stalls" means it stops moving forward.

items.question: Trong câu "received the FIN but never called close() — a code leak, not a network fault.", từ "leak" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "received the FIN but never called close() — a code leak, not a network fault.", what does "leak" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: leak /liːk/ (danh từ): sự rò rỉ tài nguyên. "Memory/connection leak" = rò rỉ bộ nhớ/kết nối do không giải phóng; "data leak" = lộ dữ liệu.
items.explanationEn: leak /liːk/ (noun): resources never released. "Memory/connection leak" means resources are never freed; "data leak" means data exposure.

items.question: Trong câu "so delayed packets are not mistaken for a new connection on the same 4-tuple", từ "mistake for" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "so delayed packets are not mistaken for a new connection on the same 4-tuple", what does "mistake for" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: mistake for /mɪˈsteɪk fɔːr/ (cụm từ): nhầm lẫn là. "Mistake A for B" = nhầm A là B; bị động: "be mistaken for".
items.explanationEn: mistake for /mɪˈsteɪk fɔːr/ (phrase): to wrongly identify as. "Mistake A for B" means to wrongly think A is B; passive: "be mistaken for".

items.question: Trong câu "TIME_WAIT is cheap, but it holds that 4-tuple, and the client's ephemeral ports run out first.", từ "ephemeral" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "TIME_WAIT is cheap, but it holds that 4-tuple, and the client's ephemeral ports run out first.", what does "ephemeral" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: ephemeral /ɪˈfem.ər.əl/ (tính từ): tạm thời, tồn tại ngắn. "Ephemeral port" = cổng tạm cấp cho kết nối đi; "ephemeral storage" = bộ nhớ tạm.
items.explanationEn: ephemeral /ɪˈfem.ər.əl/ (adjective): lasting a short time. "Ephemeral port" is a short-lived port for outgoing connections; also "ephemeral storage".

items.question: Trong câu "TIME_WAIT is cheap, but it holds that 4-tuple, and the client's ephemeral ports run out first.", từ "run out" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "TIME_WAIT is cheap, but it holds that 4-tuple, and the client's ephemeral ports run out first.", what does "run out" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: run out /rʌn aʊt/ (cụm từ): cạn kiệt, hết sạch. "Run out" = hết; "run out of something" = hết cái gì (run out of memory).
items.explanationEn: run out /rʌn aʊt/ (phrase): to be used up. "Run out" means to be used up; "run out of something" as in "run out of memory".

items.question: Trong câu "A service opening a new connection per request to one database IP:port at a few hundred requests per second exhausts those ports within about a minute", từ "exhaust" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A service opening a new connection per request to one database IP:port at a few hundred requests per second exhausts those ports within about a minute", what does "exhaust" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: exhaust /ɪɡˈzɔːst/ (động từ): dùng cạn. "Exhaust ports/resources" = dùng hết tài nguyên; danh từ: exhaustion (port exhaustion).
items.explanationEn: exhaust /ɪɡˈzɔːst/ (verb): to use up completely. "Exhaust ports/resources" means to use all of them; noun: exhaustion, as in "port exhaustion".

items.question: Trong câu "Widen the 4-tuple space (more destination IPs) if reuse is impossible.", từ "widen" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Widen the 4-tuple space (more destination IPs) if reuse is impossible.", what does "widen" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: widen /ˈwaɪ.dən/ (động từ): mở rộng ra. Hậu tố "-en" biến tính từ thành động từ: wide → widen, short → shorten.
items.explanationEn: widen /ˈwaɪ.dən/ (verb): to make wider. The suffix "-en" turns adjectives into verbs: wide → widen, short → shorten.

items.question: Trong câu "Align idle timeouts too: if a load balancer drops idle connections at 60 s but the client pool keeps them 300 s, the client writes into dead sockets and gets resets.", từ "align" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Align idle timeouts too: if a load balancer drops idle connections at 60 s but the client pool keeps them 300 s, the client writes into dead sockets and gets resets.", what does "align" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: align /əˈlaɪn/ (động từ): làm cho khớp nhau. "Align A with B" = điều chỉnh A cho khớp với B; danh từ: alignment.
items.explanationEn: align /əˈlaɪn/ (verb): to make consistent. "Align A with B" means to make A consistent with B; noun: alignment.

items.question: Trong câu "Choose UDP when late data is worthless (a voice frame 300 ms late is useless) or when you build your own reliability on top, as QUIC does.", từ "worthless" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Choose UDP when late data is worthless (a voice frame 300 ms late is useless) or when you build your own reliability on top, as QUIC does.", what does "worthless" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: worthless /ˈwɜːθ.ləs/ (tính từ): vô giá trị. Hậu tố "-less" = không có: worth (giá trị) → worthless; gần nghĩa: useless.
items.explanationEn: worthless /ˈwɜːθ.ləs/ (adjective): having no value. The suffix "-less" means without: worth → worthless; close synonym: useless.

items.question: Trong câu "Costs: UDP is easy to spoof, which powers amplification DDoS (DNS, NTP, memcached), and some corporate firewalls block it — so HTTP/3 clients always keep a TCP fallback.", từ "spoof" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Costs: UDP is easy to spoof, which powers amplification DDoS (DNS, NTP, memcached), and some corporate firewalls block it — so HTTP/3 clients always keep a TCP fallback.", what does "spoof" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: spoof /spuːf/ (động từ): giả mạo nguồn gửi. "IP spoofing" = giả mạo địa chỉ IP nguồn; nghĩa đời thường: nhại, trêu chọc.
items.explanationEn: spoof /spuːf/ (verb): to fake the sender. "IP spoofing" means faking the source address; in everyday English it means to parody.

items.question: Trong câu "Costs: UDP is easy to spoof, which powers amplification DDoS (DNS, NTP, memcached), and some corporate firewalls block it — so HTTP/3 clients always keep a TCP fallback.", từ "fallback" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Costs: UDP is easy to spoof, which powers amplification DDoS (DNS, NTP, memcached), and some corporate firewalls block it — so HTTP/3 clients always keep a TCP fallback.", what does "fallback" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: fallback /ˈfɔːl.bæk/ (danh từ): phương án dự phòng. "Keep a fallback" = giữ phương án dự phòng; động từ tách rời: "fall back to" (quay về dùng).
items.explanationEn: fallback /ˈfɔːl.bæk/ (noun): a backup option. "Keep a fallback" means having a backup option; the verb form is "fall back to".

items.question: Trong câu "AWS reserves 5 addresses per subnet (network, +1 router, +2 DNS, +3 future use, last); classic networks reserve 2.", từ "reserve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "AWS reserves 5 addresses per subnet (network, +1 router, +2 DNS, +3 future use, last); classic networks reserve 2.", what does "reserve" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to keep aside for a purpose
items.explanation: reserve /rɪˈzɜːv/ (động từ): giữ riêng cho mục đích. "Reserved addresses" = địa chỉ được giữ riêng, không cấp cho máy chủ; danh từ: reservation.
items.explanationEn: reserve /rɪˈzɜːv/ (verb): to keep aside for a purpose. "Reserved addresses" are kept aside and not assigned to hosts; noun: reservation.

items.question: Trong câu "VPCs or on-prem networks with overlapping CIDRs cannot be peered or routed without painful NAT.", từ "overlap" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "VPCs or on-prem networks with overlapping CIDRs cannot be peered or routed without painful NAT.", what does "overlap" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to cover part of the same range
items.explanation: overlap /ˌəʊ.vəˈlæp/ (động từ): chồng lấn lên nhau. "Overlapping CIDRs" = các dải địa chỉ chồng lấn; cũng là danh từ: "an overlap".
items.explanationEn: overlap /ˌəʊ.vəˈlæp/ (verb): to cover part of the same range. "Overlapping CIDRs" share part of the same address range; also a noun: "an overlap".

items.question: Trong câu "VPCs or on-prem networks with overlapping CIDRs cannot be peered or routed without painful NAT.", từ "painful" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "VPCs or on-prem networks with overlapping CIDRs cannot be peered or routed without painful NAT.", what does "painful" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: painful /ˈpeɪn.fəl/ (tính từ): gây nhiều phiền toái. Trong kỹ thuật, "painful" = rắc rối, tốn công; ví dụ "a painful migration".
items.explanationEn: painful /ˈpeɪn.fəl/ (adjective): causing much trouble. In engineering, "painful" means troublesome and costly, e.g. "a painful migration".

items.question: Trong câu "Keep a company-wide IP plan instead of defaulting every VPC to 10.0.0.0/16.", từ "default" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Keep a company-wide IP plan instead of defaulting every VPC to 10.0.0.0/16.", what does "default" (verb) mean?
options: để theo giá trị mặc định
optionsEn: to fail to repay a debt
items.explanation: default /dɪˈfɔːlt/ (động từ): để theo giá trị mặc định. "Default A to B" = để A mặc định là B; danh từ "by default" = theo mặc định.
items.explanationEn: default /dɪˈfɔːlt/ (verb): to use the preset value. "Default A to B" means to set A to B unless changed; "by default" is the common phrase.

items.question: Trong câu "IPv6 removes scarcity (subnets are /64), but IPv6-only clients need NAT64/DNS64 to reach IPv4 services.", từ "scarcity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "IPv6 removes scarcity (subnets are /64), but IPv6-only clients need NAT64/DNS64 to reach IPv4 services.", what does "scarcity" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: scarcity /ˈskeə.sə.ti/ (danh từ): sự khan hiếm. Tính từ: scarce (khan hiếm); IPv4 khan hiếm địa chỉ, IPv6 thì không.
items.explanationEn: scarcity /ˈskeə.sə.ti/ (noun): a shortage. Adjective: scarce; IPv4 addresses are scarce, IPv6 addresses are not.

items.explanationEn: recursive /rɪˈkɜː.sɪv/ (adjective): repeating a process on itself. A "recursive resolver" keeps asking other servers on behalf of the client until it gets an answer.

items.explanationEn: delegation /ˌdel.ɪˈɡeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): handing authority to another. Verb: delegate; DNS delegation hands control of a child zone to other name servers.

items.questionEn: In the sentence "Architect's choice: terminate HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 at the edge (CDN, load balancer), where clients are far and links lossy.", what does "edge" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the sharp side of a blade
items.explanation: edge /edʒ/ (danh từ): rìa mạng, gần người dùng. "At the edge" = ở biên mạng gần người dùng (CDN, edge location); "have an edge" = có lợi thế.
items.explanationEn: edge /edʒ/ (noun): network border near users. "At the edge" means at the network border near users; "have an edge" means to have an advantage.

items.question: Trong câu "Inside the VPC, HTTP/1.1 keep-alive is often fine; use HTTP/2 end-to-end when needed, e.g. gRPC requires HTTP/2.", từ "end-to-end" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Inside the VPC, HTTP/1.1 keep-alive is often fine; use HTTP/2 end-to-end when needed, e.g. gRPC requires HTTP/2.", what does "end-to-end" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: end-to-end /ˌend.təˈend/ (trạng từ): suốt từ đầu đến cuối. "End-to-end encryption/testing" = mã hóa/kiểm thử xuyên suốt toàn bộ đường đi.
items.explanationEn: end-to-end /ˌend.təˈend/ (adverb): all the way through. "End-to-end encryption/testing" covers the whole path from start to finish.

items.question: Trong câu "Non-HTTP protocols, static IPs for partner allow-lists, or TLS the LB must not decrypt → L4.", từ "decrypt" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Non-HTTP protocols, static IPs for partner allow-lists, or TLS the LB must not decrypt → L4.", what does "decrypt" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: decrypt /diːˈkrɪpt/ (động từ): giải mã. Tiền tố "de-" = đảo ngược: encrypt (mã hóa) ↔ decrypt (giải mã); danh từ: decryption.
items.explanationEn: decrypt /diːˈkrɪpt/ (verb): to make encrypted data readable. The prefix "de-" reverses: encrypt ↔ decrypt; noun: decryption.

items.question: Trong câu "The gRPC trap: gRPC multiplexes calls over one long-lived HTTP/2 connection, and an L4 balancer spreads", từ "trap" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The gRPC trap: gRPC multiplexes calls over one long-lived HTTP/2 connection, and an L4 balancer spreads", what does "trap" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: trap /træp/ (danh từ): cái bẫy, lỗi dễ mắc. "Fall into the trap of..." = mắc bẫy, phạm lỗi thường gặp; gần nghĩa: pitfall, gotcha.
items.explanationEn: trap /træp/ (noun): a hidden pitfall. "Fall into the trap of..." means making a common mistake; synonyms: pitfall, gotcha.

items.question: Trong câu "The gRPC trap: gRPC multiplexes calls over one long-lived HTTP/2 connection, and an L4 balancer spreads", từ "multiplex" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The gRPC trap: gRPC multiplexes calls over one long-lived HTTP/2 connection, and an L4 balancer spreads", what does "multiplex" (verb) mean?
options: gộp nhiều luồng trên một kênh
optionsEn: to send one at a time
to combine streams on one link
items.explanation: multiplex /ˈmʌl.tɪ.pleks/ (động từ): gộp nhiều luồng trên một kênh. "Multiplexing" = ghép kênh; HTTP/2 multiplex nhiều request trên một kết nối TCP.
items.explanationEn: multiplex /ˈmʌl.tɪ.pleks/ (verb): to combine streams on one link. "Multiplexing" carries many streams over one channel; HTTP/2 multiplexes requests on one TCP connection.

items.question: Trong câu "The gRPC trap: gRPC multiplexes calls over one long-lived HTTP/2 connection, and an L4 balancer spreads", từ "long-lived" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The gRPC trap: gRPC multiplexes calls over one long-lived HTTP/2 connection, and an L4 balancer spreads", what does "long-lived" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: long-lived /ˌlɒŋˈlɪvd/ (tính từ): tồn tại lâu dài. Trái nghĩa: short-lived; "long-lived connection" = kết nối được giữ mở lâu.
items.explanationEn: long-lived /ˌlɒŋˈlɪvd/ (adjective): lasting a long time. Opposite: short-lived; a "long-lived connection" stays open for a long time.

items.question: Trong câu "Trust X-Forwarded-For only from your own proxies — clients can forge it.", từ "forge" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Trust X-Forwarded-For only from your own proxies — clients can forge it.", what does "forge" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: forge /fɔːdʒ/ (động từ): làm giả. "Forge a header/signature" = làm giả header/chữ ký; danh từ: forgery (sự giả mạo).
items.explanationEn: forge /fɔːdʒ/ (verb): to fake. "Forge a header/signature" means to fake it; noun: forgery.

items.question: Trong câu "Light in fibre travels about 200,000 km/s: every 1,000 km adds roughly 5 ms one way, 10 ms round trip, before routing detours and queuing.", từ "roughly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Light in fibre travels about 200,000 km/s: every 1,000 km adds roughly 5 ms one way, 10 ms round trip, before routing detours and queuing.", what does "roughly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: roughly /ˈrʌf.li/ (trạng từ): khoảng, xấp xỉ. "Roughly N" = khoảng N; gần nghĩa: about, approximately.
items.explanationEn: roughly /ˈrʌf.li/ (adverb): approximately. "Roughly N" means about N; synonyms: about, approximately.

items.question: Trong câu "Light in fibre travels about 200,000 km/s: every 1,000 km adds roughly 5 ms one way, 10 ms round trip, before routing detours and queuing.", từ "detour" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Light in fibre travels about 200,000 km/s: every 1,000 km adds roughly 5 ms one way, 10 ms round trip, before routing detours and queuing.", what does "detour" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: detour /ˈdiː.tʊər/ (danh từ): đường vòng. "Take a detour" = đi đường vòng; gói tin cũng thường đi vòng chứ không theo đường thẳng.
items.explanationEn: detour /ˈdiː.tʊər/ (noun): a longer indirect route. "Take a detour" means to go a longer way; packets rarely follow a straight line.

items.question: Trong câu "Light in fibre travels about 200,000 km/s: every 1,000 km adds roughly 5 ms one way, 10 ms round trip, before routing detours and queuing.", từ "queuing" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Light in fibre travels about 200,000 km/s: every 1,000 km adds roughly 5 ms one way, 10 ms round trip, before routing detours and queuing.", what does "queuing" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: queuing /ˈkjuː.ɪŋ/ (danh từ): việc xếp hàng chờ. Danh từ gốc: queue (hàng đợi); "queuing delay" = độ trễ do chờ trong hàng đợi.
items.explanationEn: queuing /ˈkjuː.ɪŋ/ (noun): waiting in line. Base noun: queue; "queuing delay" is the time spent waiting in buffers.

items.question: Trong câu "You cannot optimise the speed of light away — move endpoints closer: CDN edges, regional deployments, TLS termination at the edge with warm origin connections.", từ "regional" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You cannot optimise the speed of light away — move endpoints closer: CDN edges, regional deployments, TLS termination at the edge with warm origin connections.", what does "regional" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: regional /ˈriː.dʒən.əl/ (tính từ): thuộc từng khu vực. "Regional deployment" = triển khai tại từng vùng; danh từ: region.
items.explanationEn: regional /ˈriː.dʒən.əl/ (adjective): belonging to a region. "Regional deployment" means deploying in each region; noun: region.

items.question: Trong câu "Chatty APIs multiply RTT: 20 sequential calls at 50 ms is a full second.", từ "multiply" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Chatty APIs multiply RTT: 20 sequential calls at 50 ms is a full second.", what does "multiply" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: multiply /ˈmʌl.tɪ.plaɪ/ (động từ): nhân lên nhiều lần. "Multiply A by B" = nhân A với B; ở đây số lần gọi nhân lên tổng độ trễ.
items.explanationEn: multiply /ˈmʌl.tɪ.plaɪ/ (verb): to increase many times. "Multiply A by B" is the maths sense; here each call adds another round trip.

items.question: Trong câu "Chatty APIs multiply RTT: 20 sequential calls at 50 ms is a full second.", từ "sequential" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Chatty APIs multiply RTT: 20 sequential calls at 50 ms is a full second.", what does "sequential" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: sequential /sɪˈkwen.ʃəl/ (tính từ): tuần tự. Trái nghĩa: parallel/concurrent; danh từ: sequence (chuỗi, thứ tự).
items.explanationEn: sequential /sɪˈkwen.ʃəl/ (adjective): one after another. Opposites: parallel, concurrent; noun: sequence.

items.question: Trong câu "Batch, parallelise, or orchestrate server-side.", từ "batch" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Batch, parallelise, or orchestrate server-side.", what does "batch" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: batch /bætʃ/ (động từ): gộp thành một lô. "Batch requests" = gộp nhiều yêu cầu thành một lần gọi; danh từ "a batch" = một lô.
items.explanationEn: batch /bætʃ/ (verb): to group into one set. "Batch requests" means grouping many requests into one call; noun: a batch.

items.question: Trong câu "Batch, parallelise, or orchestrate server-side.", từ "orchestrate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Batch, parallelise, or orchestrate server-side.", what does "orchestrate" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to arrange music for an orchestra
items.explanation: orchestrate /ˈɔː.kɪ.streɪt/ (động từ): điều phối các bước. "Orchestrate calls/services" = điều phối nhiều lời gọi; danh từ: orchestration.
items.explanationEn: orchestrate /ˈɔː.kɪ.streɪt/ (verb): to coordinate several steps. "Orchestrate calls/services" means coordinating them; noun: orchestration.

items.question: Trong câu "Cross-AZ calls are cheap in latency but billed for data transfer; keep synchronous cross-region calls rare.", từ "bill" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Cross-AZ calls are cheap in latency but billed for data transfer; keep synchronous cross-region calls rare.", what does "bill" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: bill /bɪl/ (động từ): tính phí. "Be billed for X" = bị tính tiền cho X; danh từ: billing (việc tính phí).
items.explanationEn: bill /bɪl/ (verb): to charge money for. "Be billed for X" means being charged for X; noun: billing.

items.question: Trong câu "Cross-AZ calls are cheap in latency but billed for data transfer; keep synchronous cross-region calls rare.", từ "synchronous" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Cross-AZ calls are cheap in latency but billed for data transfer; keep synchronous cross-region calls rare.", what does "synchronous" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: synchronous /ˈsɪŋ.krə.nəs/ (tính từ): đồng bộ, chờ kết quả. Trái nghĩa: asynchronous (bất đồng bộ); lời gọi đồng bộ chặn cho đến khi có phản hồi.
items.explanationEn: synchronous /ˈsɪŋ.krə.nəs/ (adjective): waiting for the result. Opposite: asynchronous; a synchronous call blocks until the response comes back.

items.question: Trong câu "Name components by what they inspect: IP/port = L4, HTTP host/path/headers = L7.", từ "inspect" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Name components by what they inspect: IP/port = L4, HTTP host/path/headers = L7.", what does "inspect" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: inspect /ɪnˈspekt/ (động từ): xem xét kỹ bên trong. "Deep packet inspection" = soi kỹ nội dung gói tin; danh từ: inspection.
items.explanationEn: inspect /ɪnˈspekt/ (verb): to examine closely. "Deep packet inspection" examines packet contents in detail; noun: inspection.

items.question: Trong câu "UDP when late data is useless or you build your own reliability; beware amplification DDoS.", từ "beware" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "UDP when late data is useless or you build your own reliability; beware amplification DDoS.", what does "beware" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: beware /bɪˈweər/ (động từ): hãy đề phòng. "Beware (of) X" = hãy cẩn thận với X; thường chỉ dùng ở dạng mệnh lệnh.
items.explanationEn: beware /bɪˈweər/ (verb): be on guard against. "Beware (of) X" means be careful of X; it is mostly used as an imperative.

items.question: Trong câu "OSI numbers are vocabulary; TCP/IP is what runs.", từ "vocabulary" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "OSI numbers are vocabulary; TCP/IP is what runs.", what does "vocabulary" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: vocabulary /vəˈkæb.jə.lər.i/ (danh từ): bộ từ ngữ dùng chung. Ý câu: số tầng OSI chỉ là cách gọi tên chung khi trao đổi, không phải thứ chạy thật.
items.explanationEn: vocabulary /vəˈkæb.jə.lər.i/ (noun): shared set of terms. The point: OSI layer numbers are just shared terms for talking, not what actually runs.

items.question: Trong câu "UDP trades guarantees for latency and underpins QUIC.", từ "underpin" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "UDP trades guarantees for latency and underpins QUIC.", what does "underpin" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: underpin /ˌʌn.dəˈpɪn/ (động từ): làm nền tảng cho. "A underpins B" = A là nền móng cho B; QUIC được xây trên UDP.
items.explanationEn: underpin /ˌʌn.dəˈpɪn/ (verb): to form the basis of. "A underpins B" means A is the foundation of B; QUIC is built on UDP.

items.question: Trong câu "L4 vs L7 balancing is raw speed versus protocol awareness.", từ "awareness" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "L4 vs L7 balancing is raw speed versus protocol awareness.", what does "awareness" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: awareness /əˈweə.nəs/ (danh từ): sự hiểu biết, nhận biết. Tính từ: aware; "protocol-aware" = hiểu được giao thức (như HTTP).
items.explanationEn: awareness /əˈweə.nəs/ (noun): knowledge and understanding. Adjective: aware; "protocol-aware" means it understands the protocol, e.g. HTTP.
